description: List current Frankfurter v1 currency codes and names with as_of, the latest served rate date. include_retired=true adds historical codes absent from the current set. Optional official ECB start_date/end_date are outer coverage bounds, not uninterrupted availability; a dated end_date does not imply retirement. Metadata outages are disclosed without failing current discovery. Historical availability remains validated from requested v1 data. Use this to disambiguate dollars (USD vs AUD vs CAD).

include_retired.description: Include historical codes absent from current v1 discovery, default false. Optional official ECB coverage dates are outer bounds and may contain gaps.

name: fx_list_currencies

as_of.description: Latest served daily rate date for this current-discovery list; historical availability is checked against historical data.

currencies.description: All supported currencies, sorted alphabetically by code.

code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, JPY).

end_date.description: Last covered date in optional official ECB metadata; a date here does not imply retirement.

start_date.description: First covered date in optional official ECB metadata; outer bound, not uninterrupted availability.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Discloses unavailable optional coverage metadata or incomplete coverage dates.

source.description: Always "Frankfurter v1" — the upstream data provider.

title: Fx List Currencies
